issues.description: Off-by-one / negative-index bug: the code tests `if i > freq * num:` then accesses `dp[i - (freq + 1) * num]`, which can be negative (e.g. num=3,freq=1,i=4 → dp[-2]) and yields incorrect results.
Nenhum arquivo de testes foi entregue. Add unit tests covering happy path and edge cases (including the case that triggers the negative-index bug).
In-place DP update is fragile and hard to reason about. Consider using remainder-group sliding windows producing an explicit ndp or explicit index guards to improve clarity and avoid subtle bugs.
Variable name `l` is ambiguous and flagged by linters (ruff/E741); consider renaming to `low` or `L`.
